author: Kusha N M
raw:
ತಂತಮ್ಮ ವಲಯದಲಿ ಉತ್ಕೃಷ್ಟ ಕೊಡುವುದಕೆ
ಅಂತರಂಗದಿ ಜನರು ಯೋಚಿಸುತಲಿಹರು
ಕಂತೆ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳನ್ನು ನೇವರಿಸಿ ಸಾವರಿಸೆ
ಅಂತರಿಕ್ಷವನೇರ್ವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: In their own spheres, people think inwardly
about how to give their very best;
if you soothe and calm the bundle of hardships,
you rise to the skies, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Everyone quietly aspires to excel in their own field. Handle difficulties with patience and calm, and you can rise to great heights.
